runtime.reason: The starter's estimate calculation and owned installation seed both read this value.

schema.description: assertConfig in shared/config.ts checks basis points against an upper bound of 10000, then checks each resulting unit price. Startup and the owned install seed require every subscription unit price after rounding to be between 1 and 2147483647 minor units, so 10000 basis points fails for any subscription product.
